name: Crates
summary: A 15-hand partnership Crazy Eights variant where players shed cards with special actions and score leftover points.
rules_text: Crates is played with 52 cards over 15 hands. Hand 1 deals 8 cards each, then 7,6,5,4,3,2,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8. Top deck card starts discard pile, establishing current rank and suit and direction clockwise. On your turn you must play a card matching current suit or rank, or an 8 or 9 wild. 8 may call any suit, 9 may call any suit of same color. 2 starts a 2-sequence: each next player must play Ace or 2 any suit, accumulating pips, until someone cannot and draws total pips. A is only playable in that sequence. Other actions: 4 skips next, 5 makes others draw one each in order, 6 same player plays again, 7 next-but-one draws one, 10 reverses direction. If unable to play, draw one. Say "one card" when left with two before playing. Hand ends when a player empties hand, unless a 2-sequence is mid-count. Leftovers score per table; threes can cover other cards for 3 points, or -50 if only threes. If deck runs out drawing, reshuffle discards except top and record escalating pressure points. Fewest total points after 15 hands wins.
